jobs.description: About this role What team will you be on? The Treasury Liquidity Management team in Dallas manages liquidity activity across our private markets fund administration platform. The team partners with Fund Accounting, Tax, Investor Services, Business Integrity, Payments and regional teams to deliver accurate, timely and well-controlled outcomes for clients. Why is your role important? You will provide a critical review and approval layer for daily liquidity monitoring, investor capital activity, credit facility administration and cash payments. Your work will help funds meet their obligations, distribute excess proceeds promptly and maintain client confidence. You will also support system and process changes that enable the platform to scale without weakening the control environment. What will you be doing? In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities: Process, review and approve daily liquidity activity, cash positions and client cash payments, challenging assumptions and confirming appropriate action to address shortfalls or excess balances. Review Limited Partner (LP) capital calls and distributions, including working papers, accounting entries, notices and payment packs, ensuring accuracy and adherence to fund documentation and service-level agreements (SLAs). Oversee liquidity across fund structures and approve cross-currency and inter-entity transfers in partnership with Operations. Review borrowing bases, compliance certificates and lender documentation for credit facility drawdowns, rollovers and repayments, confirming covenant compliance. Identify and resolve exceptions and control issues, maintain operating procedures and control documentation, and support audit and governance requests. Oversee workflow allocation, priorities and key performance indicators, serve as an escalation point for stakeholders, and provide guidance and quality feedback to Analysts. Support change initiatives and new-client onboarding, including requirements definition, user acceptance testing, control design, automation and post-implementation review. What are we looking for? Three or more years of experience in treasury, fund operations, fund administration or a comparable financial-services control environment, including responsibility for reviewing or approving deliverables. Knowledge of private markets, including fund structures, capital activity and credit facilities. Experience with eFront or a similar accounting platform is desirable. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including experience with large datasets, pivot tables, SUMIFS, lookup functions, macros and advanced calculations. Familiarity with Power BI and banking portals, including preparing and reviewing wire instructions, is desirable. A strong risk and control mindset, with attention to detail, sound judgment and a disciplined approach to escalation and evidence. Effective communication and stakeholder-management skills, with experience supporting or coaching colleagues; degree-level education or equivalent professional experience. For Dallas, TX Only the salary range for this position is USD$90,000.00 - USD$120,000.00 . Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, and benefits including healthcare, leave benefits, and retirement benefits. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self. jobs.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Roll out partner certification and enablement programs across APAC. Localize partner-facing curricula, support regional partner onboarding, and ensure channel sellers have the same product fluency as direct teams. Operate as part of a global team. Collaborate with enablement counterparts in the Americas and EMEA, contribute to global programs, and join the weekly team sync at 4pm CEST at least once per week. to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the
League of Legends
experience.
We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.
That's where you come in.
职位概述
我们正在寻找资深游戏交互设计师，作为核心交互设计师，你不只是界面原型产出者，更是全项目玩家体验体系搭建者。核心使命是以游戏世界观为基底，搭建适配的标准化交互管线，统一全系统信息架构、操作逻辑；通过可用性验证、风险前置降低玩家学习成本，打通策划、美术、程序协作壁垒，让游戏获得市面上顶级作品的交互体验。
核心职责
【
交互体系搭建】主导项目全链路交互标准制定，设计核心系统信息架构与操作逻辑，沉淀可复用交互组件库，保障全产品体验统一。
【玩家体验验证】搭建玩家可用性测试流程，基于行为数据、玩家反馈识别操作卡顿、信息过载、引导缺失等体验风险，输出可落地迭代方案并跟进落地。
【跨职能流程优化】联动策划、场景美术、客户端程序对齐交互实现边界，梳理原型、评审、落地验收标准化流程，减少反复改稿与沟通内耗。
【团队能力赋能】沉淀交互设计方法论，组织组内评审与经验分享，指导初级交互设计师，统一团队设计思考逻辑与输出标准。
任职要求
从业年限：7 年以上游戏交互 / UX 设计经验，至少 3 年手游完整项目交互负责经验。
项目经历：拥有游戏从零到一完整研发上线经验，能独立搭建整套产品交互框架、组件规范。
专业能力：精通用户体验设计方法论，熟练输出流程图、用户旅程、交互原型、落地规范；熟练 Figma/Axure/Unity，懂界面动效、引擎实现基础限制。
协作能力：熟悉敏捷研发流程，可独立组织跨部门需求评审、原型验收，具备强逻辑拆解与多方对齐能力。
加分项
深度游玩拳头相关游戏产品，熟悉相关世界观和角色设定，可以将IP 特质融入交互表达。
英语流利，可独立阅读英文需求、撰写英文交互规范，适配国际化协作。
完整从研发到上线全流程交互落地经验。
具备用户可用性测试、玩家调研、数据复盘完整实操经验。
有跨国、多区域版本交互适配项目经验。
